messages.subject: Paired Study Design
parts:
Does MSstats support paired experiment design when processing DIA data? Could you possibly explain how msstats process paired and unpaird design differently?
many thanks
yaming Liu

messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: Paired Study Design
parts:
Please see the example on page 7 of the manual
http://msstats.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/MSstats_v3.7.3_manual.pdf

With paired design, testing is based on mean of differences rather than sample means in two groups (as in unpaired design), which effectively removes the within-sample variability.
